note: The physics thread's truly-flying-fish (TFF) v2 candidates at altitude, translated into the names this checker uses. Source file: physics/flier/tff/lean-candidates-tff.json (owned by the physics thread; not edited here). What the translation changed, and nothing else: (1) the third candidate's quantities aerobic_ceiling_W and power_required_W are kept under those names and ruled on by C14b, a constraint added here for a ceiling committed as one number; (2) assumption flags were added so the constraints apply, fick_aerobic_supply for the aerobic candidate (its ceiling comes from the physiology chain, which is Fick) and lift_supported_flight was already present for the two speed candidates. Air density at altitude comes from the NASA GRC metric troposphere fit recorded in physics/flier/tff/tff.json, which is an explicit design parameter: the project's conditions file stays at sea level. The TFF itself is a hypothetical design, not an animal, and no bird data enters any of this.
translatedBy: lean/eliminate/tff-candidates.json (lean thread), from the physics thread's file
